correctness.rationale: Shellability of the rank-13 bridgeless Heawood graphic matroid gives integral homology concentrated in degree 12. An explicit oriented fixed-simplex sign gives minus the parity-signed orbit-subset forest sum, including the empty face. Exact standalone Python exhausts 336 symmetries and matches all eight traces. A separate C++ exhaustive 2^21-mask enumeration yields 1,469,920 forests and independently checks eight representative traces. Character averages are 4704/336=14 and 3024/168=18; the index-two eigenspace split is 14+4.
